properties.title: DavMail POP/IMAP/SMTP/Caldav/Carddav/LDAP Exchange Gateway - Android DAVx5 setup
properties.author: Mickael Guessant

section.name: Android DAVx5 setup
section.p: Note: you can't install DavMail directly on a phone, you need a separate DavMail server, see Android setup.

subsection.name: Install DAVx5
subsection.p: The easiest way to sync your Exchange calendar and contacts on Android is to rely on DAVx5. DAVx5 is available on Google play store and F-Droid.
The DAVx5 team checked compatibility with DavMail, see: https://www.davx5.com/tested-with/davmail-gateway

subsection.name: Create a new account
subsection.p: Open DAVx5 and add a new account. Choose Login with URL and user name.
On next screen, enter the URL, username and password, then click Connect.
